This poll has swung 10 points since then.| | | | Peter, look at this: = In June, the New York Times /Siena poll had me trailing Greg Abbott by 7 points, 51% to 44%. Now, that same poll has me ahead, 49% to 46%. That's a 10-point swing in three months, from one of the most respected pollsters in the country. It's not a fluke, either. This is the third poll showing us ahead of Abbott, and it's the most recent one, taken after weeks of Abbott's attack ads flooding Texas airwaves. = The New York Times also ran a major story on the state of play in Texas. Read this: = Ten-to-one. Abbott has thrown everything he has at this race, and he still can't put it away. Wendy Davis put it this way in the same article: "People have vastly underestimated Gina. Dollar for dollar, she's running the best statewide campaign we've ever seen." That's what grassroots supporters like you have built $5 and $10 at a time. We haven't come close to matching Abbott's money, but every dollar has gone further than anyone thought it could. = = The Times was also honest about what still stands in our way. Texas has 20 separate media markets, and national donors routinely pass the state over because reaching all of them is so expensive. And one in five Texas voters still doesn't know who I am. Here's what the last three months have taught us: the more Texans get to know me, the more this race moves. Every one of those voters is someone we can reach, but only if we have the resources to do it. Abbott has raised more than $106 million in this race, and he's going to keep spending it in the final month to drag this race back his way. We are 23 days from Election Day. The polls tell us this race can be won. What happens next depends on whether we have the financial resources to communicate our message to the voters who need to hear it. = = | | | For 32 years, Texans have been told a Democrat can't win statewide. Nvidia Still Sells Most of the World’s AI Chips. So Why Did It Pay $20 Billion for Someone Else’s Technology?
In December 2025, Nvidia agreed to a roughly $20 billion licensing deal for AI chip startup Groq’s technology. The target was inference, the work of actually running AI models rather than training them. It was a sign that even the market leader sees the next phase of AI being decided by a different kind of chip.
Threat level 3/5 — Guarded
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
For years, the AI chip story had one main character. Nvidia’s graphics processors trained almost every major model. But training is only the beginning. Once a model is built, it has to answer billions of questions a day, and that job rewards speed and efficiency more than raw power. That’s where challengers see an opening.
The evidence board
| | What the Numbers Say
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the leader.** Industry estimates put Nvidia at roughly three-quarters or more of the AI accelerator market, and above 90% in training.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the opening.** In inference, the same estimates put Nvidia’s share closer to 60%–75%, as custom chips from Google, Amazon and others win more work.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the deal.** In December 2025, Nvidia agreed to license Groq’s inference technology in a deal valued at about $20 billion, bringing over key engineers as well.

Case File No DRT-ED-KNOX · Special File · The Vault
The Last Time the Public Saw Inside Fort Knox Was 1974. The Gold Inside Is Now Worth Roughly 100 Times What Washington Says on Paper.
On September 23, 1974, the Mint’s director led congressmen and reporters into the vault. Since then, access has been rare. Meanwhile, the Treasury still values its gold at $42.22 an ounce, while gold trades above $4,000. That gap is one reason Washington keeps coming back to the same building.
Threat level 3/5 — Guarded
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
Fort Knox is the most famous vault in the world, and one of the least visited. Rumors about it come and go. What doesn’t change is the math: the United States holds one of the largest piles of gold on earth, and it still records that gold at a price set more than 50 years ago.
The evidence board
| | What We Know
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the tour.** On September 23, 1974, Mint Director Mary Brooks took members of Congress and the media inside Fort Knox to answer rumors that the gold was gone.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the return visits.** Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin visited on August 21, 2017. In February 2025, President Trump said he planned to go to “make sure the gold is still there.”
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the gap.** Fort Knox holds about 147 million ounces, carried on the government’s books at the statutory $42.22 an ounce, about $6 billion. At October’s market price of roughly $4,100, it’s worth about $600 billion.
| OUR THEORY
---
A $600 billion asset recorded at $6 billion doesn’t stay ignored forever, especially for a government looking for ways to deal with its debt. When officials keep circling the same vault, it’s worth asking what they’re really thinking about.

None of this would be possible without you [](https://ak.democrats.org/go/89216?t=1&akid=10093%2E22930333%2EfX0Lpo)
---
Derek, this is an email from the Democratic National Committee about our work to flip Congress in 7 days. If you'd like to stop receiving emails about this contest, please [click here.](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/warren-sweepstakes-2026-opt-out/?t=2&akid=10093%2E22930333%2EfX0Lpo) | [](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-warren-sweepstakes-2026.k_RvmO&amount=7&refcode=em_20261027_10093_fr&t=3&akid=10093%2E22930333%2EfX0Lpo)
---
Derek, there are three things I need you to know:
**
1. Republican billionaires are pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into helping Trump and MAGA Republicans try to keep their majorities in the House and Senate.
2. People across the country have stepped up to support candidates in critical races — helping us move **Likely-R** races to **Toss-Ups.
3. **The midterms are our chance to check Trump’s power and deliver real results for working people. We can’t wait until 2028.**

_None_ of this would be possible without the help of grassroots supporters like you.
Without you, we wouldn’t be this close to flipping Congress.
Without you, we wouldn’t be this close to winning Senate seats Democrats haven’t held in decades.
That’s why I want to meet a member of the DNC’s grassroots team to say _thank you_ for everything your support has allowed Democrats to accomplish this year.
With Election Day just days away, every resource counts, and we need to keep fighting.
[**Derek, will you chip in $7, or any amount, to the DNC today? You’ll be entered to win a chance to meet me in Boston or DC — _and_ your contribution will help support Democrats in these critical final days to win back the Senate.**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-warren-sweepstakes-2026.k_RvmO&refcode=em_20261027_10093_fr&amount=7&t=4&akid=10093%2E22930333%2EfX0Lpo)

# Missed goal
### This happened at the worst time.
| | | [Chris Pappas](https://substack.com/@chrispappasnh)
---
| Oct 27
---
| [](https://substack.com/@chrispappasnh)
---
It's Chris.
**There 's one week left of this campaign, and we need all hands on deck.**
The GOP has pledged more than $66 million trying to buy this Senate seat.
I don't take a dime of corporate PAC money.
Our strength comes from people like you, and with time running out, we need to show John Sununu that New Hampshire isn't for sale.
**[Will you chip in $10 or whatever makes sense for you right now to help us beat Sununu, keep the Granite State blue, and flip the Senate?](https://substack.com/redirect/ff17ed47-d009-4fc7-82d8-bae8680b945e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

I need to be direct with you: _**Our fundraising took a nosedive over the weekend.**_ Take a look:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ff17ed47-d009-4fc7-82d8-bae8680b945e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This happened at the worst time. We have just 7 days until Election Day. This race is neck and neck, AND we're being outspent on the airwaves.
**[I need your help to turn this around. Will you chip in to help us make up for this fundraising gap before it's too late?](https://substack.com/redirect/ff17ed47-d009-4fc7-82d8-bae8680b945e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

I don't take a single dollar from corporate PACs, so every hour we don't close the gap on our fundraising goals -- _goals that are must-hit_ -- national Republicans can continue to flood the airwaves with lies about me.
That's why my campaign is setting a 24-hour $100K emergency goal to get back on track ASAP and finalize our campaign spending plans in the final stretch.
This is the moment to be ramping up our voter outreach, not cutting back.
If we fall short today, we risk losing this seat -- _**and any shot at the Senate majority.**_

Chris

body:
You deserve to know what we're actually up against with just 7 days left until Election Day.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142327776/656572041/510768709?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTIzMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzdkM2I2ZC02N2QyLWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJkNTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KKfQPRuHteZSvWwDBqiPsnzZ00m3JOa5Qh6dLe_ifSE=) I’ll cut right to the chase: **Last month,** Bill Huizenga and the national GOP flooded Southwest Michigan with misleading attack ads, designed to bury my record under their money. **But then,** this team stepped up, and we got our own ads on the air telling voters the truth about what I've actually done for Michigan families. _That's the good part._ **But here's the part that still keeps me up at night:** we're still being outspent. | | | | | | Team Hicks,
I wanted to remind you that **today is the last day officials recommend returning your ballot via mail.**
During the May primary election, **thousands of ballots were not counted** due to late postmarks and USPS delays. Don't risk having that happen to you.
If you plan on mailing your ballot, **mail it today**. If you don’t, **please use a drop-box by 8:00 PM on November 3rd.**
You can find your nearest drop-box here: [oregonvotes.gov/dropbox ](https://us.list-manage.com/aUMHrFO8G4G?e=1074427541&c2id=346e66ad7c2541b75216140891a93cda)
This race is going to come down to a small handful of votes. **Make sure yours counts by returning your ballot today and please tell your friends and family!** Thank you,
Brad

LinkUp: Text Your Friends to Get Out the Vote

Remind your friends and family to vote by sending a text through LinkUp. A message from someone they know and trust is one of the
most powerful ways to get people to the polls.

How to get started:

1. Log in to Right Insight and tap LinkUp at the bottom of your screen.

2. Tap Sync in the top right corner to upload your contacts. Give it a moment to load.

3. You'll now see your contacts, along with their voter registration status and how they're voting.

4. Tap a contact you'd like to message.

5. If you have more than one number for that person, select the right phone number.

6. Set your organization to Minnesota Republican Party.

7. Choose a pre-written message template, or type your own, then tap Send Message.

Texts go out directly from your phone, so your friends see a message from you, just like any other text.

clean_body: One week until Election Day. Early voting is underway, and the final push runs on one thing. | Peter, Seven days from today, the polls close and Florida’s future is decided. Early voting is already underway, and Floridians are casting ballots right now. This is the part of the race where campaigns either finish strong or run out of gas. Here is what the final week runs on: the calls, the texts, the door knocks, and the reminders that get every Republican voter to the polls. All of it burns fuel every single day. The other side is not coasting. Angie Nixon’s movement turned less than $1 million into a primary win over a $16.3 million opponent. They are fully fueled for the final week and convinced they can flip President Trump’s home state. Whether you live in Florida or not, this race decides more than one state. All 28 of Florida’s Congressional seats are on the ballot. Seven days. No coasting. Thank you, Florida GOP | About the Republican Party of Florida * The Republican Party of Florida will promote the principles upon which our nation and our state were founded: freedom, liberty, personal responsibility, and accountability. We will advocate fiscally-sound, common-sense solutions that will promote job and economic growth, provide the best education to our children, and create a path to prosperity for Florida and America. Members of the Republican Party of Florida will be united by these principles and will work to elect Floridians with integrity who will work to enact such solutions. We will seek to be the most effective state party in the nation and serve as a model for other party organizations. | PAID FOR BY THE REPUBLICAN PARTY OF FLORIDA. | | | **Election Day is one week away, Peter, and one of the most exciting Senate campaigns in the country has been left behind by the Democratic Party.** In August, **Angie Nixon** , a working-class mom, labor organizer, and proud WFP member, won her Florida Senate primary after being outraised nearly _16-to-1_. More than _700,000_ Floridians voted for her. That night, the Democratic establishment put out a statement praising her. **Then they walked away.** Why? Because some corporate democrats would rather play it safe, even if it costs them the Senate, than back a candidate who wants to tax the rich, kick big money out of politics, and guarantee every family an affordable home and healthcare they can count on. **So WFP is stepping up. We just put $200,000 into digital ads for Angie. 1 And with your help, we can do even more.** [**Can you chip in $10 to the WFP General Election Fund to turn out voters for Angie and our whole slate of champions before November 3rd?**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9O0QOVbopqjffK8Bifxn8BYbymnDw1movojzLWCJ57i9KRfhw5qKQcXvQx95fnBVFiyZ7wedg4Dv38W-67iNxmTw0IY7jZw-CIz3u2GGaaoRPjYO98o4dbLL9vgW7lxysWlrUBmfngpAeahCJYx12wFbwwX22ooGFEKBeJ6RcCXsRsCTA-grf6Ump3yXGnCXvtmyDSOAgcb2N1CSFm5iaS4RoVlBp6NkB33o0La-SzmAz0R5tDzsgu0XhklqGyHcnhfhLrGc0C_dQnqpL87ElWl5Nmk71cNhFsFydGte2kg6O30owMcSf8_6H0lasMvGuBbqZUG4UMErlXnnLjUn1yA/4v9/tXpwBEhGSHykOdhi7NWX_Q/h0/h001.vYyXgMA2q3L3f3bF5AwlzTsYp5OzknJyPTEkopkEgRM) **[Donate $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9O0QOVbopqjffK8Bifxn8BYbymnDw1movojzLWCJ57i_Pl5imkooErBftl5EvZSF3SyvZawUmx2CZVnzy1k2iGl5T1p1Q877d9Jft66wvXMokd7zdfBQR7xcuOloyvVJkANGFoQbD0huFsBUzyieOMTzRMXokT1tUGfJ8c1puDyNqkiSWkNRX0e_S8o0IFHAev2hCYsyrRXghsXVtYa8rrFVRYI6q2vKvzUvhEegPGSfdQeHrxXNyTB8kGXXC5JGWYWwCWflLUEMy7lfUNOMDeZ124NaXTYf-gCdIQjL8CzeflWDopM_lHQg1Ee1YKgSDAmJfpENIWT8bbYYmgeQcJA/4v9/tXpwBEhGSHykOdhi7NWX_Q/h1/h001.6UBprjSMU6I5wQ_uY3Nt5IUTve8k-5oOCzK24Z0-Xbc)** Let’s be clear, Peter: Angie won her primary. Digital ads are how you reach voters from one end of the state to the other. Without those ads, the last thing undecided voters could see before they cast their ballots is her opponent’s attacks, with nothing to answer them. That could cost Angie the race. **We’re not letting that happen. clean_body: | | | Election Day is one week away, Peter, and one of the most exciting Senate campaigns in the country has been left behind by the Democratic Party. In August, Angie Nixon , a working-class mom, labor organizer, and proud WFP member, won her Florida Senate primary after being outraised nearly 16-to-1. More than 700,000 Floridians voted for her. That night, the Democratic establishment put out a statement praising her. Then they walked away. Why? Because some corporate democrats would rather play it safe, even if it costs them the Senate, than back a candidate who wants to tax the rich, kick big money out of politics, and guarantee every family an affordable home and healthcare they can count on. So WFP is stepping up. We just put $200,000 into digital ads for Angie. 1 And with your help, we can do even more. Let’s be clear, Peter: Angie won her primary. She earned more than 700,000 votes. Yet with seven days left, Democratic leadership still hasn't stepped up to give her campaign the funding it needs, in the exact week undecided voters are finally tuning in. In a state as big as Florida, that’s a big deal. With 67 counties and more than 13 million registered voters, no candidate can knock on every door. Digital ads are how you reach voters from one end of the state to the other. Without those ads, the last thing undecided voters could see before they cast their ballots is her opponent’s attacks, with nothing to answer them. That could cost Angie the race. We’re not letting that happen. That’s why we already jumped in with a $200,000digital ad buy to keep Angie in front of voters. And she’s holding up her end, campaigning in every corner of Florida, including the counties that voted for Trump. Angie’s not in this to build a career or get rich trading stocks. She’s running to win the WFP Guarantee: housing, guaranteed healthcare , good jobs, childcare you can afford, and time with your family, all paid for by taxing the rich. She calls the genocide in Gaza what it is. And she doesn’t fall in line just because party bosses tell her to. That scares the people who like things the way they are. But it’s exactly why we’re with her, and with our whole slate of WFP champions running up and down the ballot who are unafraid, unbought, and unbossed. When our champions win, they join a growing movement that fights for working people, takes Trump and the Republicans head-on, and doesn’t cave when the establishment gets cold feet. The more of them we elect, the less the Democratic establishment can afford to ignore them, and that’s how we go from winning primaries to winning what working families need. All year, working families have beaten record billionaire spending. Florida can be next, but only if we turn out every vote. name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: The senator who wants your kids to be afraid
body:
Plus: Greg Cunningham in studio on why CD2 decides Congress| New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/GGWH0RxGykY?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
Three Democrats said the quiet part out loud this week. A sitting U.S. senator told college students she wants them afraid to take a job in the Trump administration. A podcaster said the left has to keep firing at JD Vance. A journalist said Elon Musk should be worried about jail. We play all three clips back to back. [Three different women, one message: get on the other side and you’ll pay for it.](https://us.list-manage.com/_kyYe_zfkYn?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)

Then Greg Cunningham came to the studio. His race for CD2 is tied, and he told us why he thinks it decides who runs Congress.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/cFeZVw8agqL?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
**🚨 ELISSA SLOTKIN WANTS GRADUATES AFRAID TO WORK FOR TRUMP. SHE SAID SO ON TAPE.**
At the University of Chicago, Senator Slotkin said she wants prosecutions aimed at the people around Trump, so that young people think twice before taking a government job. She called it a “deterrence message.”
Jennifer Welch and Kara Swisher went after JD Vance and Elon Musk the same week. We explain why these three clips are the same playbook, and what it’s meant to do to the people on the other side.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/2vse3hHih9h?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**🇺🇸 GREG CUNNINGHAM IN STUDIO: “I’M NOT INTERESTED IN A SUICIDE MISSION”**
Cunningham is a retired Albuquerque police detective and a Marine. He told us why he got into the race, how he plans to take New Mexico’s worst repeat offenders to federal court, and what he’d say to a voter who isn’t a fan of Trump.
He also told us about the phone call he took the day Charlie Kirk was taken from us, and what his wife said that night. You need to hear this part.

**🗳️ THE EARLY VOTE IS IN, AND REPUBLICANS NEED TO SEE IT**
We pulled the numbers from the Secretary of State. More than 238,000 New Mexicans have voted, and the gap between the parties is wider than it should be with nine days left.
We also take on the idea that real Republicans wait until Election Day. Voting early gets you off the mailer list and saves your candidate money for the voters who are still deciding.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/ZEE58TCBlLw?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**PLUS:** The Senate map tightened in five states, and there’s a reason Republicans could still hold it. Abdul El-Sayed lost his cool with Bret Baier on Fox. Martin Heinrich got a full-page Journal ad from his own base, and for once we’re on his side. And the Halloween attack ad on Gregg Hull sounds like a Spirit store commercial.

body:
Doors, gas, and boots on the ground.

| | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Peter,
People ask me all the time: “Kailee, does my contribution REALLY make a difference?”
In a race this close?_**ABSOLUTELY, YES.**_
Races like NY-22 aren’t won by the side with the fanciest emails or tv ads. They’re won by SHOWING UP. The side that knocks the most doors, makes the most calls, and gets its voters to the polls.
_**That’s us.** But only if we can fund it._
**So here’s exactly where your money goes in these final days:**[**$25 → gets our message out there.** ](https://us.list-manage.com/KeNgNPBIRw5?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)It helps us print materials, make phone calls, and push our ads.[**$50 → fills a tank of gas.** ](https://us.list-manage.com/16dR6KO8bV4?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)NY-22 is a big district. From Syracuse to the farm towns, we’re covering every mile.[**$100 → means 100 more doors knocked. **](https://us.list-manage.com/16d_hBxhjpj?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)One hundred more conversations with voters who could decide this race.
**Our FINAL fundraising deadline is midnight on October 31, the last one before Election Day.**
We’re within range of our goal, and we’re within range of FLIPPING this seat to give New Yorkers a voice again.
**I refuse to lose this race by a handful of doors we didn’t knock.**
Will you make sure we don’t, Peter?

Thank you for fighting alongside me.
Kailee Buller

clean_body: This will come as a surprise to some. | Fellow American, I've been watching elections for a LONG time. I started all the way back in 1956 with the Dwight Eisenhower-Adlai Stevenson presidential race! Yes, Republicans are locked in tight races in red states like Texas, Ohio, and Iowa. But how many times have polls shown a Democrat landslide only to be proven wrong? If we do that, we'll flip the script on historical trends, the midterm elections, and SAVE our majorities in the House and Senate! subject: never give in, never give up, keep the faith, and keep our eyes on the prize
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=3198%2E5691347%2EVNJLTN)

Peter,
Sitting above my desk in the U.S. Capitol is a portrait of Congressman John Lewis. He was my mentor and I think about him every day.
See, when I was a teenager, I read his autobiography, _Walking with the Wind._
Growing up in Georgia, you’re steeped in Civil Rights history. He was a legend, he was my congressman, and after reading his autobiography I wrote him a letter asking if I could meet him.
Congressman Lewis gave me my first job. He instilled in me the conviction to fight for justice. He said to never give in, never give up ... to keep the faith, and keep our eyes on the prize.
I never would have pursued elected office without his encouragement and support.
But let me tell you something else about Congressman Lewis: If he were here today, he’d have very, very high expectations of us at this moment in our country’s history.
Every day there’s a new outrage. And it’s easy, I know, to fear that maybe we could lose our Republic. To want to curl up and tune it out.
But I know that Congressman Lewis would tell us to get back up and get to work ... because there is such work to be done.
We have the power to right the ship. _But no one’s going to do it for us._
Over the next 7 days, we have a responsibility and an obligation to fight and to win.
When voting rights and civil rights that heroes marched and died to secure are under attack, _we defend those rights by using them._ And that's why Georgia Democrats are planning a mobilization so massive and a defense of voting rights so fierce that no plot against the franchise will foil the will of the people.
****
Peter — my team and I have been working for months — for _years_ to build the grassroots army that will propel this campaign to victory. _Thank you from the bottom of my heart for being a part of it._
We are running through the tape, doing absolutely everything we can to get out the vote and mobilize Georgians in these final days. But I can’t do it alone. **Like every movement, it takes all of us.**
So for one of the last times before Election Day, I am humbly asking for your support:
[**Please, chip in $5 to power this campaign through these final few days and onward to victory!**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-oct26.FRbHBd&refcode=em261027-5-f&utm_campaign=em261027-5-f&amount=5&t=2&akid=3198%2E5691347%2EVNJLTN)
Thank you.
Sincerely,
Sen. Jon Ossoff

#
Peter —
We hate to come to you with bad news. But as one of James’ top supporters and someone who truly cares about taking back Texas and the Senate majority, you deserve the truth.
Our fundraising unexpectedly slowed down today, and it could have a real impact. Our team is meeting every day to figure out how best to reach undecided voters and turn out Democrats.
Every dollar we’ve already raised has been spent or allocated. When things slow down, we have to consider cuts to our budget.
We’re doing everything possible to avoid that.
So, we have two options:
1. We need more people than usual to make their first ActBlue donation.
2. Or, we need people to give slightly more than normal.

Derek:
We're just one week out from Election Day, and the pressure is on. But not for the reasons you might think...
The truth is: **I don’t want to let you down.**
_You_ are the heart of this campaign. Since the very beginning, grassroots donors have made it possible to compete with massive spending from special interests. You’ve proven that when working people come together, we can win:
* When a dark money PAC with ties to Peter Thiel dropped millions against me, you helped keep our own ads live.
* When JD Vance personally attacked me, you stood by me and helped this campaign surge ahead.
* And when crypto billionaires decided to put $55 million behind new ads trying to spread lies about me and defeat me, you helped us fight back.

But this race is far from over, Derek.
All eyes are on Ohio, and the money continues to _pour_ in.
I’m not sharing this to scare you – the polls keep proving that we have what it takes to win – but I’m writing this to remind you just how important you are to this movement.
**In the face of nearly a quarter of a BILLION dollars being spent by Republicans in Ohio, our campaign has been able to stay competitive _only_ because of grassroots donations from folks like you. And right now, I need you to have my back more than ever.**
My past races have taught me that this close to Election Day, resources are what allow a candidate to pull ahead. So we cannot give the GOP an inch.
[**Today, I’m asking you to split $20 between my campaign and the DNC. I’m counting on you. Will you give what you can to help us flip Ohio and take back the Senate?**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-brown-split.TQUheV&refcode=em_20261027_10099_fr&amount=20&t=7&akid=10099%2E22930333%2E3u1cVr)

name: Roy Cooper
subject: I need your help
body:
They're coming back to NC
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1729&source=&t=1&akid=5024%2E124072%2EsO-QjI) | | | |

Peter, I’m sorry to be so blunt, but with Vice President Vance coming back to North Carolina yet again for _another_ MAGA rally today, I have to ask:
[**_Will you chip in $5 to ensure we’re ready for whatever attacks he throws my way?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1729&amount=5&t=8&akid=5024%2E124072%2EsO-QjI)
Let me explain why your support is so important – and what could happen without it.
1\. Trump was here last month. Then just last week, he and JD Vance came to NC to rally alongside my MAGA opponent, Michael Whatley, and rile up the GOP base right before the election. Now, they are coming back _again_ to do exactly the same thing.
2\. North Carolinians are already voting. If we don’t have the resources to fight back against Trump and the GOP’s oncoming wave of attacks, their lies and distortions could be the last thing people hear before heading to the polls.
3\. My team and I set a $5 million end-of-month goal to fight back, and I need your help to reach it. Falling short would mean putting our chances of flipping this seat at risk – so we simply cannot let that happen.
**Thousands of grassroots supporters are chipping in today to fuel this movement. Now, I’m asking you to join them. Please, Peter:**
[**_Will you give $5 or whatever you can today to help us reach our crucial $5 million goal, win in North Carolina and take back the Senate?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1729&amount=5&t=9&akid=5024%2E124072%2EsO-QjI)

Roy

spending millions on attack ads, I know you’ve probably heard a lot about
me and this race.

Today, I don’t want to talk about the attack ads or my Trump-endorsed
opponent. Instead, I want to give you a chance to hear about why I’m

It’s why, as Dean of Wayne State University Law School, I worked to ensure

support.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: A last-ditch request for you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
**$3.**
That is the contribution I am asking you to make directly to Randy Villegas campaign for Congress in California.
If you are looking for a place your last-minute donation can make a huge difference, this is it. If you're looking for one of those races that can go either way and will help determine control of the House, it's Randy's race.
But he needs your help today. His campaign will see your contribution come through and be able to put it to work immediately.
If that's all you need to hear, please contribute directly to Randy's campaign. We're keeping an eye on donations at this link:
[**https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/randy-villegas**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-villegas.5SCtAj&refcode=em20261028-12491-P_FND_ANO_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=12491%2E2526796%2EiNKPem)
I was just in Bakersfield, California campaigning for Randy Villegas last Friday.
The district he is running to serve is a pretty sacred place. It puts food on the table for millions of Americans.
Every day, Americans eat food grown right there, by people they may never meet, in fields they may never see.
The families there believe that the people who feed America deserve to share in its promise. They call it the American Dream, but that dream was never handed to them. These are families essential to America's health and its economy, but it hasn't guaranteed them economic security.
This district has more people enrolled in Medicaid than any other Republican represented House District in America -- yet their Congressman voted to cut Medicaid.
Every year, the Congressman in their district collects tremendous amounts of corporate PAC money. And let me tell you, they aren't giving it to him because of the sunsets over the Central Valley. They expect ... and he delivers.
Randy Villegas won a very difficult Democratic primary, but it doesn't mean much if he can't win the general election on Tuesday.
But to do that, he needs some last minute help from people who care about taking back the House and electing good progressive candidates while we do it.
So like I said, if you are looking for a good place to make that last minute-contribution -- a place it will get put to good use, I am asking:
[ Please rush a contribution directly to Randy Villegas' campaign for Congress. This is not a split ask -- all money raised goes directly to him. He needs it, and I want to help. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-villegas.5SCtAj&refcode=em20261028-12491-P_FND_ANO_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=12491%2E2526796%2EiNKPem)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-villegas.5SCtAj&refcode=em20261028-12491-P_FND_ANO_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=12491%2E2526796%2EiNKPem)**
All of us have a role to play in deciding how the election goes on Tuesday. This is a chance to play a big part in shaping the outcome of one of the most important races on the map.
In solidarity,
Alexandria
**[Contribute Now](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-villegas.5SCtAj&refcode=em20261028-12491-P_FND_ANO_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=12491%2E2526796%2EiNKPem)**

name: Alex Vindman
subject: I am humbly asking…
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Vindman for Florida
body:
... for my brother

Peter –
First and foremost, I want to thank you for all of your support over the years. You had my back after the threats from Trump and MAGA Republicans when I blew the whistle on his not-so-perfect phone call with Ukraine – the one that led to his first impeachment.
Those were tough times for me and my family, and you were there for us.
I also want to thank you for your support during my campaign for Senate. While the race did not end the way I had hoped, please know that I will be doing everything I can to help elect Democrats everywhere this November.
And while I wish I did not have to ask again, I do. This time, not for me – but for my brother, Congressman Eugene Vindman: A man of courage, honor and integrity who is running for re-election in a tough race.
Eugene won one of the closest races in the country last cycle, and that makes him a big time target for Republicans who want to keep control of the House, and a president who'd love to defeat the second Vindman twin.
Eugene has a big end-of-month fundraising deadline coming up. And when it ends, he's got some difficult budget decisions to make about the rest of the campaign and what it takes to win.
He tells me that he's a bit short of where he needs to be right now, so I wanted to help.
So please:
[**If re-taking the House and re-electing a man of integrity to the chamber means something to you, then I am humbly asking you to make a $25 donation to my brother Eugene Vindman's campaign for Congress in Virginia before his end-of-month fundraising deadline comes to a close. This is one of the closest races in the country.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-oct26?refcode=em260830-1&amount=25&refcode2=1170_3892029_mehOe6&akid=1170%2E3892029%2EmehOe6)

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: Phew!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]
body:
[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21672?t=1001&akid=816%2E245147%2E_FGIt6 ]Headshot of Josh Shapiro

Derek, I’ll be
direct: This email is going to be on the longer side. [ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21672?t=1002&akid=816%2E245147%2E_FGIt6 ]So if you’re in a
hurry, and you already know the stakes of this election here in
battleground Pennsylvania, please use this link to rush a donation of any
size.

But if you have a minute, I hope you’ll keep reading.

I’m willing to bet you’ve heard about a few of our accomplishments here in
Pennsylvania: Rebuilding I-95 in 12 days, cutting taxes ten times, serving
over 200 million free breakfasts to our students.

But Derek, that’s
not even close to everything. So today, I wanted to do something
different. I wanted to list out nearly everything we’ve gotten done over
the last four years as your Governor (apologies if your finger gets sore
from scrolling).

* We’ve invested record amounts in public education and drove those
dollars out to the schools that need it most.

* We’ve invested millions of dollars to combat food insecurity, keep
food banks well-stocked, and alleviate the consequences of Donald
Trump’s SNAP cuts.

* We’ve created tens of thousands of new jobs and built the only growing
economy in the Northeast.

* We’ve put more money back into Pennsylvanians’ pockets through the
Working Pennsylvanians Tax Credit, tripling the Child Care Tax Credit,
and delivering the largest targeted tax cut for seniors in nearly
twenty years.

* We've repaired more poor-condition bridges than all but one state in
the country and repaired more than 22,000 miles of roads.

* We’ve invested in our Main Streets and downtowns, giving small
businesses — and communities all across Pennsylvania — the opportunity
to succeed.

* We’ve delivered over $1 billion in funding for community organizations
working to address and prevent violence in our communities, and
secured funding to hire 2,300 law enforcement officers.

* We’ve secured funding to provide stipends to 55,000 licensed child
care workers – helping keep qualified workers in the industry.

* And Derek,
we’ve done all of that while protecting your fundamental freedoms: The
freedom to choose, the freedom to vote, and the freedom to chart your
own course, without the government standing in your way.

Phew! Trust me, I know that was a lot. And believe it or not, I still made
some omissions! But I want you to hear me on this: I’m just getting
started.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21672?t=1003&akid=816%2E245147%2E_FGIt6 ]I know we can keep getting big things done here in
Pennsylvania,
Derek — but only if we treat
this election with the gravity it deserves. Please, will you pitch in
$5 or whatever you can
to power our campaign — and this entire Get Sh*t Done movement — to
victory on Election Day?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21673?t=1004&akid=816%2E245147%2E_FGIt6 ]Donate $5 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/21672?t=1009&akid=816%2E245147%2E_FGIt6 ]Other →

Thanks for having my back,

Josh Shapiro

name: Rachel Petri, Chris Pappas for Senate
subject: Facebook is taking away our biggest tools
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=9828%2E582294%2E7AgrbX ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=9828%2E582294%2E7AgrbX ]Chris Pappas for Senate

There’s an
important reason why you’re hearing from me right now.

As of yesterday political campaigns can no longer launch new ads on
Facebook or Instagram.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261028_2.NsGuHO&refcode=em20261028-2&t=1003&akid=9828%2E582294%2E7AgrbX ]Before I explain what this means for New Hampshire, will you rush
$5 or more to help us make up lost ground?

Here’s why this impacts New Hampshire more than others: Unlike most
competitive Senate races, New Hampshire does not have early voting. Over
90% of Granite Staters vote on Election Day. That means our team will be
working hard to reach every last voter and elect Chris Pappas until the
very end.

So while John Sununu and his MAGA-backers like Elon Musk are spending big
on the airwaves, we can no longer respond to their attacks on the
platforms where the majority of Granite Staters spend their time.

This political ad block seriously impacts our ability to respond to
breaking news, reach key voters, and fight back against false attacks. But
that’s not all. It also affects our ability to reach grassroots donors
like you.

Facebook and Instagram ads make up a significant portion of our grassroots
fundraising — appeals for supporters to chip in on those platforms have
historically brought in more than 15% of all the money we raised online.
But now we can no longer launch new ads to raise the money we desperately
need to keep this campaign running.

So we have to shift our campaign strategy.

First we need to find new ways to get our message out there. That means
more streaming on TV and YouTube, website takeovers, and adding to media
markets with key voters.

Second we are relying more on grassroots support from emails like this
one. With 6 days left, emails and texts directly to our supporters are our
most important fundraising tools. Every dollar we raise from emails like
this one goes straight to reaching voters on the doors, phones, and every
channel we still have.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261028_2.NsGuHO&refcode=em20261028-2&t=1004&akid=9828%2E582294%2E7AgrbX ]That’s why I’m turning to you. Your support today will
help us decide how much we can afford and how many voters we can reach in
the final 6 days. Please chip in before it’s too late.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261028_2.NsGuHO&amount=5&refcode=em20261028-2&t=1023&akid=9828%2E582294%2E7AgrbX ]Donate $5 »

Thank you,

Rachel Petri
Campaign Manager, Chris Pappas for Senate

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.chrispappas.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=9828%2E582294%2E7AgrbX

body:
#
Good morning, Peter.
In a minute, we are going to ask you to make your first online contribution to VoteVets. But first, give us a chance to explain why your support is so important.
Here’s the truth: VoteVets candidates will be the difference between a Democratic and Republican Congress in 2027.
Our organization is investing the most we ever have to get our US House and Senate candidates over the finish line. We are running last-minute ads and forcing MAGA Republicans on defense, including in races that nobody thought were winnable.
But we need your help in the final stretch: Trump’s allies are throwing in an ungodly amount of money this final week to tip the scales in their favor, and many of our races are narrowing.

body:

### **THE CROSSROADS TOUR IS HITTING THE ROAD!**
**Election Day is just around the corner, and Indiana Republicans are hitting the road!** Beginning Wednesday, October 28, our Republican statewide ticket will travel across Indiana for the [**Crossroads Tour**](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhithjd-hhlljjcji-r/), rallying supporters, connecting with Hoosier voters, and building momentum ahead of the November 3 election.Join **Max Engling, Republican nominee for secretary of state, State Comptroller Elise Nieshalla, and State Treasurer Daniel Elliott** as they make stops across the state alongside Governor Mike Braun, Attorney General Todd Rokita, Indiana Republican Party Chairwoman Lana Keesling, members of Indiana's congressional delegation, and other Republican leaders at select locations.
### **[FIND A STOP NEAR YO](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhithjd-hhlljjcji-y/)[ U](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhithjd-hhlljjcji-j/)!**
From northern Indiana to the southern part of the state, the Crossroads Tour is bringing our Republican ticket directly to communities across Indiana.**October 28 - November 2, 2026**Whether you're joining us for a rally, bringing friends and family, or helping spread the word, we want to see you there![**CLICK HERE TO VIEW ALL TOUR STOPS, TIMES & LOCATIONS**](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fhithjd-hhlljjcji-t/)With just days remaining until Election Day, every conversation, every volunteer, and every vote matters.**Let's finish strong, get Republicans to the polls, and deliver victories up and down the ballot on November 3!** We look forward to seeing you on the road! name: Jen Kiggans
subject: I'm sorry to ask again
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kiggans for Congress
body:
Not what I spent my time doing

Not what I spent my time doing
|
Peter,
I'll be honest with you... I'm not great at asking for money. It's the part of this job I hate the most.
I didn't spend my twenties learning how to fundraise to run for office. I spent them flying H-46 helicopters for the Navy and deploying to the Persian Gulf.
And when I came home, I didn't become a lobbyist who took clients out to expensive dinners. I used my GI Bill to become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. My "networking" was holding the hands of our seniors and listening to their stories, not cutting backroom deals.
That's really who I am...a Helicopter Pilot...a Nurse Practitioner... and a Mom trying to raise four happy and healthy kids in a world that feels like it's going in the wrong direction most days.
[I didn't run for Congress for the title. I ran because I looked at the country my children were inheriting, and I felt sick to my stomach. I couldn't just sit there.](https://trk.email.repdailyred.__RBOmhmc0ppLjXknKBqg)
But here is the hard truth: fighting the radical Left and standing up for our values is incredibly expensive. I don't have a massive machine behind me. I don't have someone who can write blank checks on a whim.
[I just have normal folks like you.](https://trk.email.repdailyred._)
I know things are tight right now. I see it at the grocery store just like you do. But if you can spare even $5 to help keep a Navy Vet and a Nurse Practitioner in this fight, it would mean the world to me.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: It’s not a decision I made lightly
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
The NRA and their allies had what seemed like unlimited resources, and they’d spend millions to stop us.
#

Team,
When Mark and I were making the decision about whether to start an organization dedicated to ending gun violence, we knew it wouldn’t be easy.
People told us it wouldn’t go anywhere, that no politician would put their career on the line to stand up against the gun lobby. The NRA and their allies had what seemed like unlimited resources, and they’d spend millions to stop us.
**Then, 20 innocent children and six others were killed at Sandy Hook. We knew we couldn’t sit by any longer.**
So, we founded GIFFORDS. And in the thirteen years since, we’ve turned gun safety into a winning issue. The NRA is on the run, and we’ve gotten hundreds of gun safety laws passed across the nation. It’s a big deal, and I’m proud that we’ve been able to accomplish so much together.
This work is difficult. Speaking with the families of children killed by gun violence never gets easier. But when we succeed, we save a lot of lives. And I have never forgotten that those victories come thanks to grassroots support from people like you.
Now, as I write this, the final days of the election are upon us. This moment is critical to the future of gun safety legislation in the United States. Our adversaries are putting everything on the line to prevent us from electing leaders to Congress, and we’ve committed a significant amount of resources to stand against them.
I would do this work alone if I had to, but I know we will accomplish so much more if we work together. So, I’m humbly asking you:
**[Will you please make a donation to GIFFORDS PAC to help us close out this election from a position of strength? We have a historic opportunity this year, and we can’t waste it.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q42026.PjNIJI&refcode=em261028-1-b&t=1&akid=11976%2E3935704%2ED_jw9h)

name: Angela Gonzales-Torres
subject: Angelenos deserve better, and I’m ready to deliver.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Justice Democrats
body:
Unlike my opponent, I’ll give Angelenos the bold fighter they deserve.
#
Hi Peter, it’s Angela.
Election Day is less than a week away, and this race for California’s 34th congressional district has been a long time coming. **[Before I say more, can you chip in any amount to help ensure we win?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261028-1-agt.m94dHh&refcode=em20261028-38387-other&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=38387%2E1203867%2E4XcOPI)**
**I was the second 2026 candidate endorsed by Justice Democrats** more than a year ago, and I can’t thank you enough for the support this grassroots movement has shown me.
Because of you, I’m going up against Do-Nothing Democratic incumbent Rep. Jimmy Gomez next Tuesday to give Angelenos the bold fighter they deserve. Someone who will actually vote to pass Medicare for All, abolish ICE, end the genocide in Gaza, and so much more.
Jimmy was first elected to represent our working-class community in the halls of power a decade ago. Since then, he’s stopped standing up for LA and started taking orders from his corporate donors instead.
Jimmy is backed by AIPAC, Big Tech AI lobbies, the real estate industry, billionaires, and corporate PACs — and his lackluster record shows it. Not only that, but he’s still under investigation for sexual misconduct allegations.
**With Trump’s fascism and economic inequality worsening by the day, we can’t wait for change.** That’s why I decided to run against Jimmy in the primary, and with your help, our campaign made it to the general election.
Since I don’t have the same billionaire backers and corporate interests bankrolling my campaign like Jimmy does, I’m counting on everyday people like YOU, Peter, to help us come out on top.
Last month, Jimmy’s own Chief of Staff resigned. His base is abandoning him, while our grassroots movement is gaining momentum. This is proof of years of work our community has done to unseat a corporate Democrat here in Los Angeles. _But we know this fight isn’t over yet._
**The latest poll shows us 10 points ahead** , so victory is within reach, but we can’t let our guard down against AIPAC and AI. Polling says 14% of voters are still undecided. Jimmy is the incumbent with a decade of name recognition, but when respondents learn more about me, 60% of them support our campaign!
**Last-minute voter outreach can make or break us. With your support, we’re going to knock on every door and talk to every voter in this district before November 3rd.**
**[Please, split a grassroots donation of $10 or more to my campaign and Justice Democrats now to help us reach our final end-of-month fundraising goal and win this race for CA-34.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261028-1-agt.m94dHh&refcode=em20261028-38387&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=3&akid=38387%2E1203867%2E4XcOPI)**
**[Contribute $10](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261028-1-agt.m94dHh&refcode=em20261028-38387&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=22&akid=38387%2E1203867%2E4XcOPI)**
Thanks again for everything you’ve contributed to our movement.
In solidarity,
Angela

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20261028-38387-footer&t=23&refcode2=38387_1203867_4XcOPI&akid=38387%2E1203867%2E4XcOPI)**

body:
A week out, and he still hadn’t heard from any campaign.
#
Hi Peter, it’s María Teresa.
Anyone who knows me knows I have a habit — wherever I travel, I talk to my Uber drivers. I believe there’s no better way to get to know the people in a community than a good conversation.
This past weekend, I was in Weslaco, Texas, for our rally in the Rio Grande Valley, and I had another conversation I can’t stop thinking about.
The young man I spoke with hadn’t voted yet.
When I asked him who was on his ballot,_he told me he didn’t really know._ His family kept telling him to go vote, but nobody had told him who was running or what was at stake.
Then I asked if he’d seen any political ads. He said he hadn’t heard of a single one.
**Peter, at that exact moment, an ad for Greg Abbott was playing on the radio.**
When I pointed it out, he shrugged and said all the political ads are on TV, and he doesn’t watch TV.
That’s the whole problem in a nutshell. Campaigns are pouring money into standard TV ads while voters like my driver — young, busy, and getting their information from their phones — _never see them._ They aren’t paying attention because they don’t care.**They’re tuning out because nobody is meeting them where they actually are.**
Voto Latino is changing that. We have digital ads ready to go, built to reach Latino voters on the phones and platforms they actually use, with the information they need to cast their ballots before November 3rd. All we need is the funding to launch them.
**[Peter, will you make a contribution of any amount right now to help put our digital ads in front of Latino voters before Election Day?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20261028-1.C33sd_&amount=3&refcode=em20261028-729&t=1&akid=729%2E1366028%2EgBrvUY)**

Thank you for supporting our work,
María Teresa Kumar

That's where we are in America today thanks to the jihadist-communist left. Elijah Manley, a 27-year-old Fort Lauderdale Democrat who ran for Congress this year in Florida's 20th Congressional District, [surrendered to the Broward Sheriff's Office](https://substack.com/redirect/ffa811b3-64cd-4f5e-8be2-a05118390549?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) last week and was booked into the Broward County Jail on two counts of making written threats to kill or cause bodily injury, both second-degree felonies in Florida. Manley, a DSA candidate, finished a distant third in the August 18, 2026 Democrat Congressional primary won by Rep. Debbie Wasserman Schultz, and he is one of the loudest supporters of Florida Democrat US Senate nominee Angie Nixon.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3d467195-1fc0-4824-a70e-cc7cc0e4417b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

_Mugshot of Elijah Manley. Source: Broward Sheriff 's Office_

One of them read:
_" Every Democrat needs to get behind the Democratic nominee for Senate. Anybody not doing that, I promise you I'm going to cut your [expletive] head off."_
The Broward County Sheriff's Office Threat Management Unit was tipped off the next day, when one of the two people Manley had tagged in the thread sent deputies screenshots of the posts and told them she feared for her safety. Investigators [determined the account belonged to Manley](https://substack.com/redirect/6ecb38cd-de74-4418-b726-ed34cf3c23c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and obtained a warrant. According to the affidavit, when some of his own followers asked him to ease back on his legally actionable threats of violence, he responded:
_" I'm not toning anything down. I'm tired of being told tone my voice while white people get away with destroying everything. I want all white people to vote for the Democratic nominee."_

Netanyahu, 77, is Israel's longest-serving prime minister, and many voters saw the race as on his leadership. His main rival is former military chief Gadi Eisenkot, whose son was killed fighting in Gaza. Exit polls gave the opposition bloc and Netanyahu's bloc 50, both short of the 61 needed to control the 120-seat parliament, the Knesset. Arab parties won 17 to 18 seats and could decide who governs. Preliminary results are expected today, but could take weeks or months. If talks fail, Israelis go back to the polls. King Tides Bring Floods on Both Coasts Coastal flood warnings stretch from Southern California to the Carolinas this week after Sunday night’s full Hunter’s Moon pushed seawater onto roads and up to doorsteps. . In South Florida, warnings are in effect this evening for coastal Broward and Miami-Dade counties. Parts of Fort Lauderdale , crews in Hollywood pumped water off the roads, and beachfront shops stacked sandbags at their doors. The city told residents it can’t pump the streets dry because the ocean itself is the source. When tide levels are that high, there is nowhere for the water to go until the tide drops. Saltwater also eats at cars that drive through it. California’s warnings hold through Thursday afternoon, with tides there running more than a foot above . The next round arrives Nov. 6-9. FTC Sues Dollar General Over Pricing The Federal Trade Commission and 20 states on Monday, alleging the discount chain routinely charges shoppers more at the register than the price marked on the shelf. The complaint, filed in federal court in Tennessee, says the company mislabeled prices for years and collected millions of dollars in overcharges across its 21,000 stores. Alabama, Florida, Ohio, and Tennessee are among the . Regulators say the chain failed thousands of and fielded tens of thousands of customer complaints without putting safeguards in place. Dollar General said its goal is 100% accuracy between shelf and register prices, that occasional discrepancies occur at any retailer, and that it will . The suit seeks a permanent injunction plus money for affected shoppers. ## Trump Returns to Texas Campaign Trail
President Trump rallied at the Port of Corpus Christi on Tuesday before an evening stop in Lubbock, [his third Texas visit](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OpDAMgJ8mdBklhuWnSHEN3V57JTKJsxNdIMjxwuzbn5hXuM6SJX_f5z-fyyemnPav37iRk1csy05XzSRCvNQSZcWcD2TapSIzVaEgtICBXlujYVzQSzpp6bAJbjVhsg05O0ytHT_aYWqervXt0HbGT_049TR5oMGbDieIbaQxrk1y9zlrYLTWwEf_6CL0E8SAQ78ONq6qMxSSFH7Ik4ReWGP-KSfxw5etye4pclTV_lIwK5iv63r8rSj3UsF89yiYc_GYFcw3SsFszT0PCuaDqaZAu2jh7-2o-si47xS0L3x8V-2fnKokzZjzjw6MV9VbelHQTHd72XXksum3lz6LEN-8hl04rpRzqv2gOvO1YcpvX_nfP58O_gUAAP___lKVOQ) this month, with one week left until Election Day. Trump is working to lift Republican Ken Paxton in a [competitive U.S. Senate race](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDtu6zAURFcjdTL4Ez8Fi9e482tTClfkpU2AEgXyxnZ2H8hbSDkY4GDmfN2WG-SS9_t_2NDTO9Vlx1cvSIRt6TXRCqUc0HCnDq1hJ4yEi2BCT5xNwi4QKD9xUTBGv7Lo-IieGye5naVx48M7ppPUwVllbeLagNSznFeD0prEVRizP3GcCcs5E7O-qCS0EymC0avhaR0Uw5iptgs9kPANPZWf-sR2CXUbi38QHX2Q_wZxHcQVjvPCWZ2hUQ4FB3HdciRsW58-gIna93ZMB7yp7hNBgZZDnZzSIdpZCzUHboyWfE5cKXAamFytGJuPxyuXkrs2g2L3DXL5rKC_2nt68RsAAP__3CiDnA) against Democrat James Talarico. Texas hasn't elected a Democrat to statewide office in 32 years, and Talarico planned his own events on Tuesday in Midland, Amarillo, and Lubbock. Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio also planned to tour [an oil tanker of Venezuelan crude](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL_OpCAUxZ8GOwygI1pQbGM3225pQC7jTVAIXMfZt__ivMLXneLkd_78ey5PixGP11-7g6FPSMsBV41ABGWpKZCzMWZb4KBqS4FK4AkWJdTApeBqXOxK-Ialt403TvhJNmCknjo5Pjo9NZvRY_Crl9YJ3evVrcKKbtTeBZiGaZWPBs2Nk0KNUgr1GNo-qGFSwVs9OC2DY70Aj5RKSxsQfGwN8X96Q2nXtDfRbES5su4PUzNT83VdbU4RCdd0G5ia701MzXcMU7MUt9ZMzeV0mDils-Dx4l8yv5A2TuXcM7eV0wY8F6jo4SBebIwIldcz51QISuVCym4QemqK8fnCGLEOmvXitVuM337021_fRv0EAAD__zTQju0) bound for Texas refineries. Trump has touted his August deal giving the U.S. majority control of Venezuela's oil reserves as a way to lower gas prices. The trip marks the first time Rubio, who also serves as national security adviser, has [hit the road with Trump](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQhZ_G7ohgMNgUFNuku9tuaQ1muEHCP4KJk92nXzmvcMujI3065_vzNX9hLnn7_o0reX6nfd7o1QoxU53bnjhgKQdW2rhhrdSYItMMEqxQUsA048L5pHnAPvogo1M9eTU6rSajR9c_fBicDmlaJjONiGaBRSdnjE3RqoQW-uwvnJIwKSXB2NuQwDpIEUcbRpVCN0iKmfd64wcxvbGl8nc_qd6Wfe2LfzAfrdO_Orh3cMfjunBVV6icl0Id3Lk-10PUZ8i7-DDEmiNTXZs4aaN_Tyoo9lxEiJEsjc5CCEpqFaQZUgI1LdFop1NffTxeuZTc7NgN8nvFXD5L-KcGTw__AwAA__9_l4cN) this campaign season. Texas Children's Hospital in Houston has opened what Attorney General Ken Paxton calls [the nation's first detransition clinic](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGy3CAMhk-DO3ZA68V2QZHG3Uub0oNBPGvCggeU9eb2GfYK6TS_NJ8-6dfX9uUoUf7-6Z5o-R3LlvFqCZmxbq1E3l1Kp6uYublasTEGxg0UGKmVhHlznumF2-iGYHcVFj2g1dNy1_PjPi3DYUc_ziYoCIAmGD86mB5-DuYR9qDjMg9kO04rmLVW8DC3MYJZIAY3mX3ScRejwkBc6o0PZHy7FtPf8sJ68-U5JHswn03cfwhYBazXdd18Iv8bjvKnccl9SsDaDxOwpuJdErD2nQJWrXo99b5jKrnJSLWxDMjV5UY9kz5RJi_LiblJx_LjIP1BKdQeHaWdxB_sUG04L0qJmpnEqL6fjtLHk__3vy8L_wIAAP__ouiSPA), a requirement of the $10 million settlement the hospital reached with his office in May. Peter,
I was a freshman at West Point when the Twin Towers fell.
None of us who were there will ever forget that morning. We'd signed up to serve a country at peace. By that afternoon, every cadet in my class knew we'd be going to war.
Not one of us flinched.
Over nine combat tours in Afghanistan and Iraq, I flew the Apache attack helicopter and then MH-47G Chinooks with the 160th SOAR "Night Stalkers," carrying special operators into places most Americans will never see. I did it because I love this country more than I love my own life. Every man on those birds felt the same way.
**And I’m still committed to fighting for this country today – but what I see happening here at home terrifies me.**
_Here 's why._
America has never been beaten from the outside. After Pearl Harbor, we rallied and won a world war. After 9/11, we took the fight to the terrorists who attacked us. Give our warfighters what they need and put them on any battlefield against any enemy on earth – and we win.
Abraham Lincoln understood this almost 200 years ago. He said the danger to America would never come from abroad. "If destruction be our lot," he warned, "we must ourselves be its author and finisher."
**That 's exactly what the radical Left is doing. Brick by brick, they're tearing America down from the inside.**
**_Our sovereignty?_** They threw open our southern border and allowed cartels to smuggle in dangerous drugs and criminals. They voted against requiring proof of citizenship to vote. A nation that can't control who comes in or who casts its ballots isn't a nation for long.
**_Our culture?_** They sneer at the flag, the troops, and the Constitution those troops swore to defend. Faith, family and hard work – the things that built this country – they treat as something to be ashamed of.
**_And our kids?_** That's what keeps me up at night. The Left wants our children taught that America is rotten to the core. That the greatest gift they'll ever receive – being born American – is something to apologize for.
A generation that's taught to hate its country won't defend it. And the socialists know it.
Today's Democratic Party isn't the party your parents knew. Socialists from the DSA wing are running the show now. And the so-called moderate, pro-America Democrats? They've had every chance to stand up to this monster. They've proven they either won't or can't.
_So it 's up to us._
**And in just a matter of days, the socialists have a real shot at taking back the House.**
Our majority is razor-thin. Democrats don't need a wave – they need to flip just a handful of seats. **Every single race in the country is on the table, and they 're pouring money into all of them at once.**
If they pull it off, Hakeem Jeffries gets the gavel. And the socialists get the keys.
| [FIGHT BACK](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=f29a83bd404c4e9f8cc229e056fb96f6&_e=6p4BN3HsqgvrrTf-OGkaZZ-OgCRwFmCLNHRRK4NTxwbGYMuy9UOj12ThMAGSQsDyismnSHXUfFEWiBSCGOxisLYKuunjeV4ef0siIUgbDMIk7U_AtR9qBmsWgWq1XX9sSEwcjtJCIGxtwdua_PMSTgzWamEjctfdBqvCS6FkeJpK_vXKBiG9NFk-8KOI6bjuz9pHzM0Irc4gEXgvvfN7hUPFx1jiyIFOmS9Y-0liQDPLC3EnkW4tfQ7TXUCWXtkX-8xWXd5kfHFMy-ZYq121qDMwlXFHBPm0eYYUKCCdtNsdisaFhbyvm4X7_aYhPURISpReSqo4ehDHIIWRqsSyDADgNIx6H8V_sDyF46W5luuf31ver3uREISUST42SeNAwGUDZ5jZmVEwRrFDIevgWTRV1yCLgKe7bpFSSMe4FJUPinQte7TmJotuvndDJD6YTVfh2yawtQaC2Jds40jXGfcEWR14CGqfaXRt755mF4MhO6u6q99pIBhrkUuk2iWGnyRqTigoqym5klqTy9PWB8XLj-Y0rP4CSCjaWhEXBaDE0W6vmhEtzP79aP0Y3h73Zk0S6TSrIFgDRV0ETsSQgzkM5OZQLdRY60hnaRKFQijaXuswzms6AYcHvag95t4RHq-FQJ-yjW8NA99l1DYHecQF9D5n29QkwnzorBhG1dLX3aKIUAsOuBi8aUVQY_awPg92O6eRAqELUIrPpOf2_Ldl2BvnjGGFFlgf5vLzKiz8hyuo1ln9aYffrrzCYMJMduCCiylAqIN0OOAeXSU1gA%3D%3D)

You know what comes next. Endless witch hunts. Impeachment circuses. Every bill to secure the border and protect our elections will be dead on arrival. Two more years of the Left fighting to undo everything we've accomplished – and setting the stage to finish the job in 2028.
**This is the whole ballgame. Not one race._The entire House._**
I know that fight better than most. Last December, when our majority was on the line in Tennessee's special election, national Democrats threw everything they had at it. We beat them by nearly 9 points. Now they want revenge – on me and on every Republican standing between them and power.
**In just a matter of days, it all comes down to Election Day.** The Democrats and their media allies are watching every close race for a Republican who looks weak. Wherever they see weakness, they'll pile on. Wherever they see strength, they'll think twice.
_That 's why I'm coming to you directly._
**I 'm asking you to stand in the gap over these next few days – because right now, the House is the line, and we need patriots holding it.**
[**Will you rush a gift of $26 or more before Election Day to help defend our House majority and stop the socialist takeover?**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=f29a83bd404c4e9f8cc229e056fb96f6&_e=6p4BN3HsqgvrrTf-OGkaZZ-OgCRwFmCLNHRRK4NTxwbGYMuy9UOj12ThMAGSQsDyismnSHXUfFEWiBSCGOxisLYKuunjeV4ef0siIUgbDMIk7U_AtR9qBmsWgWq1XX9sSEwcjtJCIGxtwdua_PMSTgzWamEjctfdBqvCS6FkeJpK_vXKBiG9NFk-8KOI6bjuz9pHzM0Irc4gEXgvvfN7hUPFx1jiyIFOmS9Y-0liQDPLC3EnkW4tfQ7TXUCWXtkX-8xWXd5kfHFMy-ZYq121qDMwlXFHBPm0eYYUKCCdtNt21BHE3uz__OlXroL7Uo-IpZu1GhGcWj5KE0AkEGCxP3QbrSZGSLTa_gdCXBtuq2wSrfX7G4zrmbjs2J0S0KG24VsjmwAUas3cDSA5Qs-6vk08pKWAFlXCD-7w6ZdxORer-AREHUjESjrvijl0u_fER-J7wxbjxqXL3nuwbCj2TBfP5NYPUGenYicAEP38vxTgg7z524IRUvEJe8QUjIGCg1SZAf19YghO_NFkBxl-PJ_Mjhi3usQDDFmjOLbQEsdGxdrrsU5Pz7YIvCU4pjwlEG5bvex0H-Hy073kUdLbgy4RvDl0UZ_8XQZJtdBf2MTSVcZnGqsq_kpM__0-T0RSJY_3Lc140_xf9zYv3nQWP6x_OemAsx1l5G_vc3Gf3DCRiHC2hDJoivFG0HxN8lkqYERw75jZvkZfS6KFjd7uaQsuKyoq9fZfNzylbdLo4LZLbiazwf_ENGkM_EIRjKwIFNhTilxZFYBtl5NmQX9Ppg%3D%3D)
The country's on the line and the threat is coming from within. That’s why I'm asking you to answer the call with me – for our sovereignty, for our way of life and for the kids who deserve to inherit the same America we did.
**Please don 't wait. The clock is running.**
For God and country,
Matt Van Epps

###### **Hello Friends and Family!**
I am honored to serve as the Mini-THON Captain for the Games and Rules Committee, where I get to combine my love for bringing people together with a cause that means so much to me: helping kids conquer childhood cancer through [Four Diamonds Mini-THON](https://substack.com/redirect/1d80cb5f-4492-4ce3-be5c-0d772336bfef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
What I love most about Mini-THON is seeing how something as simple as coming together as a community can make such a lasting difference in a child's life. My school and every committee work tirelessly throughout the year, dedicating countless hours to fundraising, planning, and creating an unforgettable night for our students and Four Diamonds families. Together, we have raised over **$2 MILLION** in the past 20 years, and I am so proud to be part of a tradition that continues to grow.
Every dollar I help raise supports Four Diamonds' life-saving research to better prevent, diagnose, treat, and ultimately cure childhood cancer. Beyond research, I am proud to help ensure that every Four Diamonds child, regardless of their family's income, receives the highest quality childhood cancer care without ever having to see a bill for that care.
Since 1972, Four Diamonds has supported more than 4,800 children and their families. Being able to play even a small role in that mission is something I truly value. Mini-THON has shown me that making a difference does not always require doing something extraordinary--it can start with simply showing up, caring deeply, and bringing others together for a cause bigger than yourself.

We're talking about state supreme court races in places like Michigan, Ohio, and North Carolina. We're talking about state legislative elections that could flip the balance of power in key chambers. Here’s the truth
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=160%2E42639%2EUQB_3U)
Like most campaigns, we send a decent amount of fundraising emails. Fewer than most, but not an insignificant number.
So I thought it was important to take a moment to explain why these requests are so important to our campaign. You deserve an explanation.
First, the greatest source of individual donations our campaign receives comes in response to emails like this one. Hard to believe maybe (or maybe not), but it's true.
Ok, so what do we do with those donations that we couldn't do without these email requests?
First, I represent the last Democratically-held battleground House seat in Pennsylvania. Without these emails, without our ability to fundraise, we'd be in a hell of a fight right now. But as it stands, I think we have a good chance to win on Tuesday.
As you may know, Pennsylvania also has a number of flippable House races that are critical if Democrats are going to take back the House. I've been doing A LOT of campaigning for some of those candidates and getting around the state takes resources.
And finally ... the question I get asked a billion times: am I going to take on John Fetterman if I win? Maybe? We'll see... but any donations I receive can be used toward that if I decide to run. But that is an after the election question.
That is why I ask. That's why these emails are so important.
So for the last time this election, here it goes:
**[Can you please make a contribution to my re-election campaign today? Our average online donation is around $30. Many give more. Some give less. All that matters is lots and lots of people are chipping-in what they can.](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q4.4eyHU-&refcode=em261028&t=2&akid=160%2E42639%2EUQB_3U)**

name: Grassroots Army
subject: You can't stay home.
body:
Our week hit millions of people. Now we need you at the ballot box.
---
| GRASSROOTS ARMY
---
Army, Election Day is almost here — **Tuesday, November 3**. And I need you to hear this plainly: **You can't stay home.** Not this time. Not when every seat, every race, every margin matters. Staying on the couch isn't "sitting this one out." It's handing your voice to someone who will gladly use theirs against everything you believe. We don't win by hoping. We win by **showing up**.
* Make a plan: when you'll vote, where you'll vote, and who you're bringing with you.
* If you already voted early — thank you. Now help one more person get there.
* If you're tired — good. Tired people still vote. That's how republics survive.

**Show up. Vote. Bring someone with you.** [I'm voting — make your plan](https://9l762.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsDg0fV3Ji0XTonBupr9Lp/k32xWapmWYEe)
* * *
**What you did this week** While we fight for November 3, look at what this Army already did last week (Oct 19–26):
* **314 posts** across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, Threads, and YouTube
* **339,749 reactions · 30,402 comments · 96,378 shares**
* **~10.5 million Facebook impressions** , plus nearly a million Instagram + TikTok views

Your top posts weren't soft. They were clear:
1. **"God is not mocked"** (Last Supper) — our biggest of the week: millions of impressions and half a million Instagram views alone.
2. **"I don't vote red because I 'worship Trump'"** — more than 1.3 million Facebook impressions. This is about the country, not a personality.
3. **"We will never crawl for the state"** — more shares than likes. That is the heart of this movement.

Every one of those numbers is a real person who saw the truth and passed it on. That is the Grassroots Army. But we don't win by preaching to the choir. We win when ordinary people do extraordinary things — starting at the ballot box.
* * *
**Why grassrootsarmy.org is Coming Soon** You've followed us on social. That is where the fire starts. The website is where we build the home base:
* A place to **enlist** (memberships + numbered cards), not just scroll
* A shop that funds the fight, printed to order in the USA
* Weekly recaps, ways to get involved, and — soon — LIVE so we can talk to you directly

Coming Soon is not stalling. It is finishing the foundation so when we go fully LIVE next week, we are ready to grow the Army for the long fight after Election Day — not just the next news cycle. Until then: **vote first.** Then keep sharing. Keep recruiting. Keep standing. I'll see you on the other side of Election Day — standing, not sitting. For God and Country,
**Dr. Garrett Soldano D.C.**
Grassroots Army P.S. Make your voting plan today — then share it with one friend who still needs a push.
**GJS Investments LLC**
8357 Barony Pt, Mattawan, MI 49071

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com because you subscribed to Grassroots Army updates.
[Unsubscribe](https://9l762.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/un/v2/sh/1t6AVsdYhqSR1mLJmycafKClcNaT5x/V2tpjLqnJvzN) · grassrootsarmy.org (Coming Soon)

[ Abdul ]Abdul sipping a latte

Peter, coffee is
more than a hobby for me. It's a love affair.

I roast my own beans at home, grind them fresh, and pull the shot myself.
Every once in a while, I manage some half-decent latte art.

"Why go through so much effort?" you might ask. Because when something's
worth doing, it's worth doing right. The same goes for this campaign.

We won one of the most expensive primaries in this country’s history
without taking a single cent from corporate PACs or AIPAC, and I’m not
about to start taking any shortcuts for the general election.

I’m committed to staying 100% unbought and 100% people-powered because I
know that’s the morally right thing to do — but that comes with its own
set of challenges.

Mike Rogers isn’t following the same set of rules:

* He’s gobbling up as much corporate PAC money as he can get his hands
on.
* He's urged the biggest MAGA spenders to invest $100 million to help
him flip Michigan red.
* And now AIPAC is getting involved too.

As a result, we’re being massively outspent over the airwaves. That means
when undecided voters turn on their TV or open their phones, they’re more
likely to see an anti-Abdul or pro-Mike Rogers ad than hear from our
campaign. That’s not good.

We still have time to turn this around, but that window is closing
extremely fast. Today marks 6 days until Election Day, and many
Michiganders are already voting early or by mail.

So, here's my humble request for you: [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1738?c0=em-ms-aes-20261028-1-ak.7d6lCe&refcode=em20261028-3778&t=1006&akid=3779%2E251025%2E_9tAko ]Can you fuel our campaign by
pitching in $6, the price of a cup of coffee, today? Every dollar
translates to more Michiganders hearing from our campaign before they go
to cast their ballot.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1738?c0=em-ms-aes-20261028-1-ak.7d6lCe&refcode=em20261028-3778&t=1007&akid=3779%2E251025%2E_9tAko ]Donate $6 ››

Thank you so, so much. 🙏

Your friend in the fight,

Abdul

Meet Mark Harris:
**Mark Harris is a father, grandfather, pastor, and now a sitting member of Congress who has spent his life in service to his faith, his family, and the people of North Carolina.

Born and raised in Winston-Salem, North Carolina, and a graduate of R.J. Reynolds High School, Mark earned a Bachelor of Science in Political Science from Appalachian State University. Not long before marrying his college sweetheart, Beth, he felt a calling to ministry, going on to earn his Master of Divinity and Doctor of Ministry in Christian Leadership from Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary.

Mark spent decades in pastoral ministry across North Carolina and Georgia, leading congregations at Center Grove Baptist in Clemmons and Curtis Baptist in Augusta before becoming Senior Pastor of First Baptist Charlotte, where he served for more than a decade and guided the church through difficult economic times without taking on debt.

Mark now represents the people of North Carolina's 8th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, where he serves on the Agriculture, Education and Workforce, and Judiciary Committees, fighting every day for pro-family values, lower taxes, and a government that actually listens to the people it serves.

Mark and Beth have three adult children and eleven grandchildren, and call North Carolina home.

Now, Mark is running for reelection because North Carolina deserves a fighter in Washington who will never stop standing up for faith, family, and freedom. **

body:
Tonight, I took some time to reflect on the last 10 years we have shared.
| | | | **THIS COULD BE MY FINAL WEEK AS PRESIDENT**
---
[READ MY CRITICAL REFLECTION](https://link.email.donaldjtrump.-w/sfvdd0b7b64)
[](https://link.email.donaldjtrump.-w/sfvdd0b7b64)
Never in the history of my Presidency have I sent anything quite like this to my supporters. Dear Friend, this is your only warning. What I’m about to share with you is emotional **- PREPARE YOURSELF.**

[READ MY CRITICAL REFLECTION](https://link.email.donaldjtrump.-w/sfvdd0b7b64)
The Rose Garden is almost sacred at night.

When the cameras are gone and the noise of the day finally fades, it stops being a backdrop for press conferences and power plays.

It becomes what it was always meant to be: a quiet, living garden right beside the White House.

**_And last evening, in what could be my final 4 weeks as President, I took some time to reflect on the last 10 years we have shared as I strolled alongside the rose bushes._**

[READ MY CRITICAL REFLECTION](https://link.email.donaldjtrump.-w/sfvdd0b7b64)

Your faith in me still humbles me more than I can put into words.

From the highest of highs to the lowest of lows, I have always been able to count on your support.

From an unproven, underdog political candidate to the leader of our nation's GREATEST movement in history, you have always stood by my side.

Even when it would have been easier to write me off.

For the past decade, the Radical Left has done everything in their power in an attempt to destroy the MAGA coalition.

They came for me, my family, friends, and above all: my supporters.

People like you, Friend.

When the chips were down, you stared evil straight in the face and never flinched.

You put your career, family, and even LIFE on the line to continue supporting me, and I will never be able to thank you enough.

Every single day I wake up, I pray and thank God for his blessing of being able to be your President.
And every night I go to sleep, I pray for the opportunity to spend one more day fighting to make America Great Again.

**And in the Rose Garden late last evening, I made one final prayer before leaving:**

**__That my supporters will keep their trust in me one final time and help see the rest of my mission through.__**
